facts.text: pumpy3 controls a Harvard syringe pump over an RS-232 interface and supports the PHD 2000 and the PHD Ultra
The supported features are set pump volume, set pump diameter, set infuse and withdraw rate, set target volumes and wait until target volume
The example creates Chain serial objects and pumps at addresses 0 and 2
The PHD 2000 only takes notice of target volumes after it has been put into volume mode with the keypad
The PHD 2000 sometimes does not wait until infusion or withdrawal is finished
Chain opens the serial line with a 115200 baud default, two stop bits, no parity, eight data bits and a 2 s timeout
Pump2000 stores the configured pump address as a two-digit string with '{0:02.0f}'
Pump.write prefixes the stored pump address and terminates every command with a carriage return
Pump.setdiameter states that the syringe diameter range is 0.1-35 mm
Pump.setinfusionrate says the accepted flow-rate range depends on the syringe diameter and is given by the pump manual
Pump.settargetvolume says the accepted target-volume range depends on the syringe and is given by the pump manual
Pump2000 queries VER during construction, requires 'PHD' in the reply and reads the status character ':' (idle), '>' (infusing), '<' (withdrawing) or '*' (stalled)
Pump2000.run writes RUN and Pump2000.rev writes REV, then records the reported state
Pump2000.stop writes STP, reads the reply, pauses 0.1 s and raises if the state still reports infusing or withdrawing
Pump2000.set_rate maps m/m, u/m, m/h and u/h to MLM, ULM, MLH and ULH and writes the rate with four decimals
Pump2000.settargetvolume sets the target volume in mL with MLT
Pump2000.getdiameter queries DIA and reports the number in mm
Pump2000.getrate queries RAT and RNG and reports the rate and the first four characters of the RNG reply
Pump2000.ivolume queries VOL and reports the infused volume in mL
Pump2000.gettargetvolume queries TAR and reports the target volume in mL
